BiblicalUsage: Shucham was a son of Dan, and his family, the Shuhamites, numbered sixty-four thousand and four hundred in the census of the wilderness. His name heads the whole tribe's count in the second numbering.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a tribe can be counted by one man's name. Dan's families are summed up under Shucham, and I hold that God numbers His people family by family, not in a faceless crowd.
